comments.body:
**merge-train (2026-11-17): not on this train — one finding to fix.** Validated at `bad49616e`.

The intended fix works: a person with no chats who opens an unshared agent link now sees the no-access stage, and reverting `Portal.vue` turns the new test red.

**Finding — the new `threadsLoaded` guard (`src/frontend/src/views/Portal.vue:3154`) stops agent-page landing whenever the thread list did not load cleanly.** `threadsLoaded` only latches on a clean sessions read (`:2398`) and is not a watch source (`:3140`). While `store.sessionsFailed` is true, clicking an agent in the sidebar moves the URL but the stage does not follow.

Reproduced in this PR's own harness: `arm({ sessionsFail: true })`, boot on `/workspace/c/t1`, emit `open-agent 'sage'` from `PortalSidebar`.

| `Portal.vue` | URL after click | Conversation on stage |
|---|---|---|
| `dev` | `/workspace/a/sage` | `sage`, `newChat: true` |
| this PR | `/workspace/a/sage` | `scout`, `newChat: false` |

So a live composer for one agent sits under another agent's URL, and it only recovers if a later clean read changes `threads.length` — a person with zero chats never recovers. `dev` handles this path correctly today.

The guard itself is needed (removing it turns `portalDraftLanding.mount.spec.js` red), so this needs your call on what "thread read settled" means when the list failed — land as `dev` does, or show a failed state — plus a test for the failed-list side.

Optional, same area: a cold link to a reachable, non-first agent with zero chats (`/workspace/a/sage`) still shows the first agent, on `dev` and here alike. Adding `threadsLoaded` as a fourth watch source fixes that (the five neighbouring specs stay green) but does not fix the finding above.

Rides the next train once fixed. `status-needs-fix` is set; on a fork PR it does not clear on push, so a maintainer removes it on re-review.

**merge-train (2026-11-19):** validated at `92433054b`. The 11-17 finding is closed: with a failed thread list, clicking an agent now lands on it, and flipping `sessionsFailed` on a landed page neither mints a second chat nor resets the composer.

One narrower case was left, and I pushed the fix for it to this branch (`9255e1db3`) so the PR can ride today:

- **What was wrong:** `threadsLoaded` gates the landing watcher but was not one of its sources. A person with no chats who clicks a non-first agent while the first thread read is still in flight never lands, because the read settles empty and `threads.length` stays 0. The stage kept the first agent under the clicked agent's URL.
- **What changed:** `threadsLoaded` is now a watch source (`Portal.vue`, one line plus a comment). This also fixes the cold link to a reachable non-first agent with no chats, which was the optional note from 11-17.
- **Tests added** to `portalUnavailableTargets.mount.spec.js`: the in-flight click (red before the change), and a cold `/workspace/a/sage` load with a failed list, which pins the `sessionsFailed` source you added (it goes red if that source is removed).

The ten neighbouring Portal mount specs and the three ratchets pass, 183 tests. @pcbeingused333 please pull before pushing anything further. One thing left as is, for a follow-up if it matters: a cold link that lands a new chat during a failed read stays on it when a clean list arrives later.
